title: Parrot holding a balloon
svg:

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 78 Q22 86 26 92 Q32 88 34 82 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M33 80 Q28 90 34 94 Q38 88 37 82 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
